EC1: Use of any oral antidiabetic treatment [AND] [NOT] except for metformin (i.e., sulphonylureas [OR], DPP-IV inhibitors [OR], thiazolidinediones [OR], SGLT-2 inhibitors [OR] (Sodium dependent glucose transporter) or GLP-1 analogues (glucagone like peptide) within the last three months prior to Screening
EC2: Repeated episodes of severe hypoglycaemia within the last six months prior to Screening
EC3: History of diabetic ketoacidosis [OR], precoma diabetica [OR], or diabetic coma
EC4: Treatment [AND] with any other investigational drug within the last three months before Screening
EC5: Acute infections within the last four weeks prior to Screening
EC8: Anamnestic history of hypersensitivity to the study drugs [OR] or to drugs with similar chemical structures
EC9: History of severe [OR] or multiple allergies
EC10: Concomitant participation in other clinical trials
EC12: Cardiovascular disease Clinically relevant ventricular tachycardia [OR] or ventricular fibrillation [OR], 3rd degree AV block [OR] or Torsades de Pointes [OR] or treatment [AND] with antiarrhythmic drugs [OR]. Percutaneous coronary intervention [OR] within the past 6 months. Any of the following within the past 6 months: myocardial infarction (MI) [OR], coronary artery bypass surgery [OR]; unstable angina [OR]; or stroke.
EC13: Malignancy including leukemia [OR] and lymphoma within the last 5y.
EC14: Liver disease such as cirrhosis [OR] or chronic active hepatitis.
EC15: Significant renal dysfunction (see also exclusion criteria laboratory abnormalities).
EC18: Systolic blood pressure [OR] outside the range of 100-160 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure above 95 mmHg at Screening
EC19: History of active substance abuse (including alcohol > 40g/day) within the past 2 years.
EC20: Pregnancy [OR] or childbearing potential [NOT] without adequate contraception
EC22: Presence of psychiatric disorder or intake of anti-depressive [OR] or anti-psychotic agents [NOT] with the exception of benzodiazepines [OR] and SSRIs [OR]/SNRI's (selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor)
EC23: Potentially unreliable subjects [OR], and those judged by the investigator to be unsuitable for the study.
EC24: Contraindications [AND] for Magnetic resonance (MR) scanning such as persons with cardiac pacemaker [OR] and implants out of metal [OR] or claustrophobia
